English: An error occurred. Please try again.
Welsh: Digwyddodd gwall. Rhowch gynnig arall arni.

English: Some letters could not be delivered:
Please enter a valid email address.
Please remove excessive links before sending your message.
Welsh: Rhaid cael gwared ar ddolenni gormodol cyn anfon eich neges.

English: Please keep your message respectful. Abusive, threatening, or spam-like content will be blocked.
Welsh: Cadwch eich neges yn barchus. Bydd cynnwys sarhaus, bygythiol, neu debyg i sbam yn cael ei rwystro.
Dewiswch Gynrychiolwyr i Gysylltu â Nhw
Mae eich llythyr wedi cael ei anfon!

English: Your representative will receive your letter directly by email.
English plural (if shown): Your representatives will receive your letter directly by email.
Welsh: Bydd eich cynrychiolydd yn derbyn eich llythyr yn uniongyrchol drwy e-bost.
Welsh plural: Bydd eich cynrychiolwyr yn derbyn eich llythyr yn uniongyrchol drwy e-bost.

English: Any reply will go straight to %s — keep an eye on your inbox, including your spam folder.
Welsh: Bydd unrhyw ateb yn mynd yn syth i %s — cadwch lygad ar eich mewnflwch, gan gynnwys eich ffolder sbam.
Notes: Keep %s unchanged; it is replaced with the sender's email address.

English: Response times vary. Most representatives aim to reply within two to four weeks, though it can take longer during busy parliamentary periods.
Welsh: Mae amseroedd ymateb yn amrywio. Mae'r rhan fwyaf o gynrychiolwyr yn anelu at ymateb o fewn pythefnos i bedair wythnos, er y gall gymryd mwy o amser yn ystod cyfnodau seneddol prysur.

English: If you don't hear back, you can follow up or contact your representative directly through their official contact channels.
English plural (if shown): If you don't hear back, you can follow up or contact your representatives directly through their official contact channels.
Welsh: Os na chewch chi ateb, gallwch chi gysylltu â'ch cynrychiolydd yn uniongyrchol drwy eu sianeli cyswllt swyddogol.
